items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1958-06-19, 20
items.q: I used to play with him too... When we had the band there, he used to come around and sit around, you know, and play something.

ctx.x: Oh, did you ever run into Jolly Row Martin, the Wyandand boy?

Jolly Row Martin, I know him well. I used to play with him too. Where? He was from Monroe, Monroe, Louisiana. He was around Shreeport. When we had the band there, he used to come around and sit around, you know, and play something. He'd be working on a job like that. He'd tell the fellas, get up, let me play something. He'd get up and he'd play something, you know. That's the way the musicians were.
Did he play pool a lot in those days, do you remember? Huh? Did Jolly Row play pool much in those days too? Pool?

Did he play pool a lot in those days, do you remember? Huh? Did Jolly Row play pool much in those days too? Pool?

Yeah. Yeah. He used to play pool, around Shreeport. And Pensacola kid would come into town like Alexander, you see, and he'd find out who's the best pool player in town and he'd lay around for a big game, you see. And when he'd get that big game, he'd fixin' to leave there then, you know, about $150 or two, $300. He's going to win that. He'd make the ball any way he want, any time, steal it, anything. And so when he left Alexander, he disappeared and we went to Chicago. We found him there running a pool hall for…
